introHtml: For commercial kitchens, safety is non-negotiable. Custom flame resistant kitchen accessories like the Therma-Grip Large Oven Mitts and Pot Holders provide heat protection up to 500°F, giving your staff confidence when handling hot equipment. Unlike standard kitchen textiles, these accessories meet rigorous safety standards while offering full-color customization for your brand. Perfect for restaurant chains, food service contractors, and culinary schools that demand both performance and professionalism.
